data.standardized_narrative: For the 2019 financial year, Syndicate 4242 reported a prior year reserve strengthening of USD 14.898 million, representing 4.27% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening was calculated from the gross claims development triangle. While the Managing Agent's report noted more benign loss activity in 2019 compared to 2018, the re-estimation of older underwriting years (2017 and prior) resulted in an increase in reserves. The report highlights general uncertainties in claims estimation, including the impact of judicial decisions, government legislation, and the use of internal modelling techniques. The Syndicate also noted material exposure to Hurricanes Harvey, Irma (2016/2017 YOAs) and Florence, Michael (2017/2018 YOAs), which increased overall reserve uncertainty. A specific uncertainty related to a reinsurance asset balance for the 2017 year of account was also noted.
